valueRange.notes: Readbacks confirmed Projector.N.Connected returns 0 or 1 across populated and unpopulated projector slots. Direct Object Tree boundary writes are not applicable to this hardware connection state.

entries.notes: Runtime readback-only evidence on 2026-05-14 issue #298 confirmed Projector.N.Connected as a 0/1 hardware connection domain. Concrete paths Projector.0.Connected and Projector.1.Connected read 1, while Projector.2.Connected read 0.

locationContext.indexBasis: Projector.N uses the zero-based Object Tree projector index.
locationContext.notes: The runtime probe used populated Projector.0 and Projector.1 slots plus unpopulated Projector.2 in the loaded hardware setup.
